changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Stop the upgrade while a person data erasure is admitted and not complete. The previous release froze its selection while copied identities were part of the review item detail, so this release does not resume it. Complete each one on the previous release, then upgrade. Every erasure after the upgrade is selected by this release.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Each copied identity belongs to its review item and goes with it. Only the four providers that can copy a person's words appear.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.review_item_copied_identity ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_review_item_copied_identity_member FOREIGN KEY (review_id, practice_id, item_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES public.review_item(review_id, practice_id, item_id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_item_copied_identity_provider CHECK (provider_type IN ('GITHUB', 'GITLAB', 'SLACK', 'OUTLINE'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE public.review_item_copied_identity DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_item_copied_identity_provider, DROP CONSTRAINT sfk_review_item_copied_identity_member

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Move each review item's distinct copied identities out of its detail into their rows, in one transaction. EXCEPT drops a duplicate and a copy that is already a row, so a second run adds nothing. The upgrade stops every role, so no server reads the detail list any more.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.review_item_copied_identity (workspace_id, review_id, practice_id, item_id, provider_type, provider_origin, subject, team_id) SELECT m.workspace_id, m.review_id, m.practice_id, m.item_id, copy->>'providerType', copy->>'providerOrigin', copy->>'subject', copy->>'teamId' FROM public.review_item m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.detail->'custody'->'copiedIdentities') copy WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.detail->'custody'->'copiedIdentities') = 'array' EXCEPT SELECT workspace_id, review_id, practice_id, item_id, provider_type, provider_origin, subject, team_id FROM public.review_item_copied_identity; UPDATE public.review_item SET detail = detail #- '{custody,copiedIdentities}' WHERE detail->'custody'->'copiedIdentities' IS NOT NULL;

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup. A capture that this release recorded can copy more people than the review item detail of the previous release holds.
